kai: Quick heads-up: discovered an onboarding quirk in the sampleapp SDK flow. When we enable prefetch + auth refresh jitter the paginator sometimes replays a cursor after retry and we temporarily exceed quota.

nina: Can you paste the minimal repro? is it specific to node?

kai: Node only so far. Steps: start 150 clients, set token TTL=3s, enable prefetch=2, run for 30s. After rotation we see duplicate POSTs for cursor token and a spike in soft-429s.

rui: Sounds like duplicate sends during retry. Do we have any dedupe key on the client?

kai: No, just naive enqueue on requeue. Thinking to add a tiny dedupe cache keyed by (cursor,page_size) with 50ms TTL to suppress immediate duplicates.

nina: That works as a band-aid but we should fix SDK retry semantics: don't release permit on retry or ensure requeue reacquires before releasing. Also add parity note for go/python.

ci-bot: Created ticket #DEVEX-412 for SDK fix and sampleapp test coverage. CI will run stress job when PR is open.

rui: OK I'll prototype the dedupe and add unit tests. If we standardize a small client-side dedupe window it might reduce incidents while we fix the permit ownership bug.

kai: Thanks—placing patch as draft next.
